desc: Ideation: reduce f(L,R) to the number of connected components of the distinct values in A[L..R], and select the O(N) right-endpoint sweep approach.

Implement and verify the O(N) right-endpoint sweep in Python: maintain prev[v], T = sum_L f(L, current_i), and ans; update T using delta = (i - 1 - p) - max(0, pm - p) - max(0, pp - p), then T += delta + 1 and ans += T. Sample tests passed.
